name: cavemio-agent-composer
title: Agent composer
description: The taller composer for agent surfaces: branch, folder and context on a tab above, permissions and model as pills that grow into their lists.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The field is labelled by its placeholder; Send, Stop, Speak and Add files are labelled buttons, and the mic says whether it’s pressed.
- Both pickers are listboxes with arrow keys, Home, End and Escape (see Model picker), announced as "Permission: Auto" and "Model: Aurora".
- The tab’s branch and folder have visually hidden labels, and the context ring reads as "57% of the context used"; amber and red always come with the figure.
- The breathing disc only runs while listening and stops with reduced motion.
- Installs Model picker, Number roll and Text morph.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: – · Called with the text on Enter or Send.

props.name: onStop
props.description: – · Turns the spinner into Stop while streaming.

props.name: branch / folder
props.description: – · On the tab above the card; they morph when they change.

props.name: context
props.description: – · The ring on the tab; amber from 80%, red from 95%.

props.name: models / model / onModelChange
props.description: – · The model pill (see Model picker); effort and onEffortChange add thinking effort.

props.name: permissions
props.description: Auto, Ask first, Plan only, Full access · The permission modes, each with a name, a line and an icon.

props.name: onFilesSelected / accept / attachments
props.description: – · Enables +, paste and drop; render chips in attachments and they fold open above the prompt.

props.name: onVoice / listening
props.description: – · Shows the mic and whether it’s listening.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: "What should we build?" · Also the field’s label.

useCases.title: Coding agents
useCases.description: A prompt box that shows the branch, the folder and how full the context is.

useCases.title: Ops and DevOps agents
useCases.description: Let people choose whether the agent asks first, plans only or acts on its own.

useCases.title: Internal AI tools
useCases.description: Staff pick the model, and the thinking effort for models that reason, before they send.

useCases.title: Research and writing agents

features.title: Where the agent is working
features.description: The branch and project folder sit on a tab above the prompt and morph when they change.

features.title: How full the context is
features.description: A ring fills with the share used, turning amber at 80% and red at 95%, always with the figure beside it.

features.title: How far it may go
features.description: A permission pill opens into a list such as Auto, Ask first, Plan only and Full access. Pass your own list.

features.title: Model and thinking effort
features.description: The model pill grows into its list, with an effort setting for models that reason.

features.title: Send, then Stop
features.description: It follows the AI SDK’s status: the arrow becomes a spinner, then Stop while the answer streams.

features.title: Files and voice
features.description: Add files with the plus button, paste or drop, and show a microphone that breathes while it listens.

states.title: ready
states.description: Type; Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line; the field grows to 220px, then scrolls. Send is dim until there’s text.

states.title: submitted / streaming
states.description: The arrow blurs into a spinner (submitted), then into Stop while streaming if onStop is set (260ms blur, scale 0.6→1).

states.title: status tab
states.description: Branch and folder morph letter by letter when they change; the context ring eases to its new share (600ms) and its figure rolls, turning amber at 80% and red at 95%.

states.title: permission / model
states.description: Each pill grows into its list (Model picker’s one-surface morph), opening above the composer and lined up with its left or right edge; choosing morphs the pill’s label.

states.title: listening
states.description: With onVoice, the mic turns primary and a soft disc breathes behind it until it’s pressed again.
